{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Thresh-ahantu Azuloz''' was an individual who was a well-known enemy of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], the leader of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Thresh-ahantu Azuloz was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
